examples.title: Turn on a detailed trace for teleportation only
examples.goal: A warp is broken, but you do not want to flood latest.log with the whole mod.
examples.result: In `config.json` (or `main.json` in split mode) set `logging.categories.teleportation.debug` to true, then reload. The category's routine output still goes to the console/`latest.log` with `normal: true`; debug goes only to `logs/debug.log`. Warnings and errors are never silenced by either key.

examples.title: Remove the "Player issued command" line from the console
examples.goal: On a busy server the commands.normal category prints every player command.
examples.result: `logging.categories.commands.normal: false` stops writing these lines after a reload. The commands themselves work as before. Command registration errors are still visible.

edgeCases.title: There is no separate mod log file
edgeCases.body: Debug goes to the platform's standard `logs/debug.log` (Log4j2), not to `logs/neoessentials/`. The `auctionHouse` category in the config is camelCase; the enum in code may look different, but the JSON key is exactly `auctionHouse`.
edgeCases.fix: Look for the trace in `logs/debug.log`. Do not create an empty `logs/neoessentials/debug.log` by hand — the mod does not write debug there (that folder gets, for example, the economy's transactions.log).

edgeCases.title: 12 categories, not a single switch
edgeCases.body: Keys: chat, economy, permissions, teleportation, moderation, auctionHouse, kits, webDashboard, discord, config, commands, general. `general` covers everything without its own category (storage, holograms, shop, localization, vault).
edgeCases.fix: If "nothing is logged" after enabling debug, you enabled the wrong category. For a warp that is teleportation, for /pay it is economy.
